第627章 夜洐你可敢踏入天庭（第1页）
夜洐，你可敢踏入天庭？（夜洐，你可敢踏入天庭？（第22页）一声冷嗤从夜洐口中发出：“无聊。”帝袍女子见状，确定慕容幽今日无法出现，便没有任何顾及，周身帝威骤然暴涨，威压铺盖天地压向四方，凤眸寒冽：“你凭阴毒卑劣的控魂之术伤本宫之人，如今便想缩头避战？岂有此等便宜之事！”帝袍女子身后轰然腾起一尊横贯天地、遮断日月的女帝法相。鎏金帝袍垂落万丈流苏，冕旒悬垂，神光浩荡，一手握帝印、一手持天规，磅礴帝道法则翻涌，顷刻间风云倒卷、日月失辉，整片天地都被这股无上皇威震得微微震颤。在场一众老牌尊者尽数神色剧变，脊背发寒，眼底翻涌着难以掩饰的忌惮与惊骇，下意识往后退了半步。“滚出来！夜洐，你往日行事百无忌惮，今日怎反倒怯了？”“仗控魂禁术肆意妄为，今日定要讨回公道，重重惩戒于你！”“魔道之辈只会躲在暗处行凶，可敢走出阴影，堂堂正正决一胜负？”仙、佛两道各路正道人物接连出声，声势浩大，为帝袍女子造势。今日正道齐聚此地，不仅仅只是旁观，也想逼迫厉邪姒立下血誓，决不能再动用控魂禁术协助夜洐胡作非为，祸乱仙子。刚才夜洐的态度，让她们更加坚信，慕容幽就是遭遇控魂所迫，连神幽侯都挡不住神魂禁术，世间女子又有几人能够抗住？一时之间，天地间尽是仙子神女声讨斥责之音。一旁蛰伏观望的妖魔势力反倒尽数缄默，他们也期待夜洐出现，展露滔天魔威，令魔道扬威。面对众人逼迫，夜洐漫不经心声音，再度响起：“无聊闹剧，我夜洐行事，只分生死，擂台之战自娱自乐留给尔等天真之人。”“只分生死？好！”帝袍女子凤眉一挑，霸气回荡云霄，“本宫自封境界，与你修为持平，敢便出来，当场一决生死！”夜洐静静注视盛气凌人的帝袍女子：“这种流于形式的擂台，无趣，分不出真正生死，不必心急，我自会寻你，定要让你笑不出来。”这番狂言，对帝袍女子而言没有半分震慑之力。反倒惹得全场诸多修士暗自嗤笑。就连周遭观战妖魔强者，也觉夜洐太过狂妄自大。连他最大倚仗魔尊厉邪姒，都不敢对帝袍女子放出这般狠话。“好，本宫静候你的邀约，何时何地，留下话来。”帝袍女子步步紧逼。四下无数道戏谑、讥讽的目光齐刷刷投向夜洐，暗笑他口出狂言，如今被女帝逼到进退两难，无力招架的份上了，狂徒被女帝给治了吧，治的死死的。夜洐一言不发，不会泄露半分计划，一个字都不会泄露，一旦引得帝袍女子心生戒备，便难以成功。见夜洐沉默。帝袍女子唇角勾出一抹轻蔑，更加霸气傲然声音再度响起：“既然你不敢定下时日地点，那本宫便做主了，本宫即将开启天庭之路，夜洐你可敢踏上天庭？！”

Chapter 627 Ye Xi, do you dare to step into the heaven (page 1)
Ye Hui, do you dare to step into heaven? (Ye Wei, do you dare to step into the heaven? (Page 22)) A cold sneer came from Ye Wei's mouth: "Boring." Seeing this, the woman in imperial robes was sure that Murong You would not be able to appear today, so she did not take any care. The emperor's power suddenly surged, overwhelming the world and pressing in all directions. His phoenix eyes were cold: "You hurt the people of this palace with your vicious and despicable soul control skills, and now you want to shrink your head and avoid the battle? How can it be so cheap!" The woman in imperial robes said Behind him, a statue of the female emperor suddenly rose across the sky and the earth, blocking the sun and the moon. The gilded emperor's robes were drooped with thousands of tassels, and the crown was hanging. The divine light was majestic. He held the emperor's seal in one hand and the heavenly rules in the other, and the majestic laws of the emperor surged. In an instant, the wind and clouds rolled back, the sun and the moon lost their light, and the whole world was slightly shaken by this supreme emperor's power. The expressions of all the veteran venerables present changed dramatically, their spines trembled, and their eyes were filled with unconcealable jealousy. Afraid and horrified, he subconsciously took a step back. "Get out! Ye Hu, you acted without scruples in the past, how come you are so cowardly today?" "You act recklessly with the power of soul control. Today, you must seek justice. I will punish you!" "The demons only hide in the shadows to commit crimes, but they dare to step out of the shadows and decide the outcome in an upright manner?" Immortal and Buddhist figures from all walks of life spoke out in great force, creating a situation for the woman in imperial robes. Righteous people gathered here today, not only to watch, but also to force Li Xiesi to make a blood oath, never to use the soul-controlling forbidden technique to help Ye Wei do anything and cause trouble to the fairy. They were even more convinced that Murong You was forced to control his soul. Even Shen Youhou could not stop the forbidden divine soul technique. How many women in the world could resist it? Suddenly, the world was filled with the voices of fairies and goddesses condemning and reprimanding her. . The demonic forces who were waiting and waiting were all silent. They were also looking forward to Ye Wei's appearance, showing his overwhelming demonic power and making the demons powerful. In the face of the crowd's persecution, Ye Wei's careless voice sounded again: " It's a boring farce. I only care about life and death. I leave the entertainment of the battle in the arena to you naive people. If your cultivation level is the same as yours, come out if you dare and fight to the death on the spot!" Ye Hao quietly looked at the domineering woman in imperial robes: "This kind of arena is just a formality. It's boring. It can't tell the difference between real life and death. Don't worry about it! Don't worry, I will look for you, and I will make sure you don't laugh." These arrogant words did not scare the woman in imperial robes at all. Instead, many monks in the audience laughed secretly. Even the powerful demons watching the battle around them. , I also feel that Ye Hao is too arrogant. Even Li Xiesi, the demon king he relies on the most, dare not say such harsh words to the woman in the imperial robe. "Okay, I am waiting for your invitation. Leave a message when and where." The woman pressed forward step by step. Countless joking and sarcastic glances from all around were directed at Ye Wei, secretly laughing at him for speaking arrogantly. Now that he was forced into a dilemma by the empress, he was unable to resist. The madman was punished by the empress. Come on, I'll do it to death. Ye Hao won't reveal even a single word of his plan. Once he makes the woman in imperial robes wary, it will be difficult to succeed. Seeing Ye Hao's silence, a look of contempt appeared on the lips of the woman in imperial robes, and her voice sounded even more domineering and arrogant: "Since you don't dare to set the time and place, then I will make the decision. I am about to start the journey to heaven. Ye Hao, do you dare to set foot in heaven?!"
